answer: Sybil resistance follows from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: only sustained honest service preserves weight, while inactivity or recent behavior rapidly decays it. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because no established peers endorse them. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity prevents them from crossing consensus, even when sybils harbor mutual praise; their influence horizon remains negligible, like jade dust.
